svg.title: GridFlex AI — recorded engine workload 71.731 to 2.246 ms
svg.desc: Hajar Mrifag, AI, systems and product engineering. Featured: GridFlex AI, with its real workspace screenshot. Recorded 60-day shift plus battery engine workload fell from 71.731 to 2.246 milliseconds, about 32 times. Historical engine timing, not HTTP latency; the screenshot scenario is separate from the benchmark.
